export default "# Logs\n\nOpen **Logs** from the sidebar to reach the Logs landing page (`/logs`). The landing page asks \"What logs are you looking for?\" and presents dimension cards — **Services**, **Hosts**, **Processes**, **Files**, and **All logs**. Pick a dimension to browse log volume grouped by that field, or choose **All logs** to open a full log query in Query Lab.\n\n## Logs Explorer\n\nThe query-first explorer UI lives at `/logs-explorer`. You can reach it by navigating directly to that path. The explorer provides a query-visible workflow where every filter and search action updates the ES|QL editor.\n\nUse the **Lines / Chart / Patterns** toggle to switch analysis modes while keeping a single visible ES|QL query source of truth.\n\nUse the **Search logs** input for free text. Enter plain text to generate `message : \"...\"`, or wrap the text in quotes to generate `MATCH_PHRASE(message, \"...\")`.\n\nUse filter chips to review and remove active clauses. Chips, search text, and query editor all contribute to the same ES|QL query.\n\nThe timeline above results is always visible. Anomaly buckets are highlighted; click a highlighted bucket to append a `CHANGE_POINT` drill-in pipeline to the query editor.\n\nUse the **Field Filters** sidebar to quickly include (`+`) or exclude (`-`) common dimensions such as `service.name` and `log.level`.\n\nClick any table cell to add an inclusion filter for that field/value pair. Clicking a `trace.id` cell pivots to Query Lab with a trace-scoped query draft. Clicking a `message` cell opens extract controls for `DISSECT` / `GROK`; extracted fields are added to the sidebar filter list immediately.\n\nIn **Patterns** view, grouped message signatures support quick drill-in by applying quoted search text and preserving chip/search/editor sync. Use **Run CATEGORIZE patterns** to append a `CATEGORIZE(message)` aggregation query.\n\nEdit the ES|QL directly in the editor when you need full control. Press **Search Logs** (or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter) to run the current query.\n\nClick the **Explain Query** button in the bottom-right corner of the ES|QL editor to toggle a plain-language explanation of the current query. The explanation is generated by the configured AI provider; if no provider is set up, the panel displays a note to configure one in Settings.\n"
