export default "# Tips & Shortcuts\n\nElastic Peek includes keyboard shortcuts and productivity tips to help you navigate and work faster.\n\n## Keyboard shortcuts\n\n| Shortcut               | Action                                                                |\n| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| `Ctrl/Cmd + K`         | Open the command palette                                              |\n| `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + A` | Toggle the AI Assistant drawer                                        |\n| `Ctrl/Cmd + Enter`     | Run the current ES\\|QL query (Query Lab, Panel Editor, Logs Explorer) |\n| `Arrow Up / Down`      | Navigate between rows in Query Lab while the row inspector is open    |\n\n## Command palette\n\nPress `Ctrl/Cmd + K` to open the command palette. From the palette you can:\n\n- Jump between pages without using the sidebar.\n- Open connection settings.\n- Toggle dark/light mode.\n- Load recent queries.\n- Search docs sections by keyword.\n\nOn narrow or mobile layouts, tap the **search icon** in the header to open the same palette.\n\n## Quick actions\n\n- **Rename a dashboard** — click the dashboard title in the header to edit it inline.\n- **Switch themes** — use Dark/Light Mode in the settings menu (gear icon in the sidebar footer).\n- **Disconnect** — click the Disconnect button in the connection dialog to drop the active connection.\n- **Reset all state** — use Reset All State in the settings overflow menu to wipe connection and dashboard data back to defaults. This is irreversible.\n\n## Navigation tips\n\n- Use the sidebar to move between pages. The active page is highlighted with a left border accent.\n- Pages that require a connection are disabled when no cluster is connected.\n- The Docs page is always accessible, even without a connection — use it as a reference while configuring your cluster.\n"
